name: deepseek_v4_hc_boundary_norm_hidden_size5120
description: DeepSeek-V4 mHC sublayer boundary (deferred hc_post, collapse with the previous pre, mix statistics, reduce and Sinkhorn) and the RMSNorm of the collapsed row.

projection_size.description: Mix projection input: the four streams.

x.description: The previous sublayer's output, whose hc_post was deferred to this boundary.

residual.description: The four residual streams before that hc_post.

post_in.description: The previous sublayer's post mix: weight of x in new stream k.

comb_in.description: The previous sublayer's combination mix: weight of stream j in new stream k, at [j, k].

pre_prev.description: The previous boundary's pre mix: weight of new stream k in this sublayer's input.

hc_fn.description: Projects the flattened new streams to 24 mix logits: pre, post, then comb.

hc_scale.description: Scale of the pre, post and comb logits.

norm_weight.description: Weight of the RMSNorm of y.

rms_eps.description: Added to the mean square of the new streams (DeepSeek-V4: rms_norm_eps).

norm_eps.description: Added to the mean square of y (the norm's variance_epsilon).

hc_eps.description: Added to each pre mix after its sigmoid and in each Sinkhorn normalization.

sinkhorn_iters.description: Sinkhorn normalizations of the combination mix.

residual_out.description: The new streams: the deferred hc_post applied, in residual's dtype.

norm.description: RMSNorm of y, the next sublayer's input.

pre.description: This boundary's pre mix: sigmoid(...) + hc_eps.

comb.description: This boundary's combination mix after Sinkhorn, at [j, k].

sources.content:
"""Device code and launch of one DeepSeek-V4 mHC sublayer boundary with the RMSNorm after it, as a
single Triton launch per boundary on gfx950.

Grid (H / 64 + 16, cdiv(M, 16)), the hidden-slice axis fastest so that a row tile's CTAs are dispatched
together:
  slice CTAs (H / 64 per 16-row tile) apply the deferred hc_post to a [16, 64] slice of the four
  streams (stored bf16), collapse them under the previous pre mix, accumulate the mix-logit and
  sum-of-squares partials (the fp32 hc_fn split into three bf16 MFMA products), then wait on a
  row-tile barrier and RMS-normalize their own slice (with the MXFP8 codes and E8M0 scales);
  sinkhorn CTAs (16 per tile) wait on the same barrier, reduce the partials of one row and run
  the sigmoid / Sinkhorn mixes.
The barrier counters are per-shape scratch zeroed once; the last arriver of a tile resets them, so
every launch finds them at zero.
"""

import functools

import torch
import triton
import triton.language as tl

_BLOCK_M = 16
_BLOCK_K = 64
_NUM_WARPS = 2
_SYNC_STRIDE = 64

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- device helpers
@triton.jit
def _fp8_grid_quant(xg):
    """fp32 [G, 32] -> (fp8 e4m3 codes, ue8m0 exponent per group); mxfp8_amd_gfx95.fp8_grid_quant."""
    amax = tl.max(tl.abs(xg), axis=1)
    amax = tl.maximum(amax, 1e-10)
    raw = amax * (1.0 / 448.0)
    bits = raw.to(tl.int32, bitcast=True)
    exp = (bits >> 23) & 0xFF
    exp = exp + ((bits & 0x7FFFFF) != 0).to(tl.int32)
    exp = tl.minimum(tl.maximum(exp, 1), 254)
    scale = (exp << 23).to(tl.float32, bitcast=True)
    scaled = tl.clamp(xg / scale[:, None], -448.0, 448.0)
    return scaled.to(tl.float8e4nv), exp


@triton.jit
def _arrive_and_wait(cnt_ptr, TOTAL: tl.constexpr):
    """Row-tile barrier with no cache maintenance: callers write what they share through to memory
    (.wt) and wait for the acks before arriving; readers use coherent .cv loads afterwards. cnt
    counts arrivals; the last arriver resets it and bumps the generation flag (a separate 128-byte
    line) the others spin on with relaxed coherent loads. Self-resetting: every launch starts at 0.
    The generation is read (relaxed, coherent) before arriving: it can only advance after this
    CTA's own arrival."""
    flag_ptr = cnt_ptr + 32
    gen = tl.atomic_add(flag_ptr, 0, sem="relaxed", scope="gpu")
    old = tl.atomic_add(cnt_ptr, 1, sem="relaxed", scope="gpu")
    if old == TOTAL - 1:
        tl.atomic_xchg(cnt_ptr, 0, sem="relaxed", scope="gpu")
        tl.atomic_add(flag_ptr, 1, sem="relaxed", scope="gpu")
    cur = tl.atomic_add(flag_ptr, 0, sem="relaxed", scope="gpu")
    while cur == gen:
        cur = tl.atomic_add(flag_ptr, 0, sem="relaxed", scope="gpu")
    tl.debug_barrier()


@triton.jit
def _sinkhorn_row(
    row, part_mix_ptr, part_sq_ptr, scale_ptr, base_ptr, pre_ptr, post_ptr, comb_ptr,
    M, inv_k, rms_eps,
    MIX: tl.constexpr, HC: tl.constexpr, NUM_SLICES: tl.constexpr, SLICES_PAD: tl.constexpr,
    ITERS: tl.constexpr, EPS: tl.constexpr,
):
    """mhc_boundary_hip._hc_mix_reduce_sinkhorn_row: the split-K partials read as ONE
    [slices, 32] tile with coherent .cv loads (other CTAs wrote them through), the pre / post /
    comb mixes picked from the reduced row by exact one-hot sums (stock: a scratch round trip);
    the sigmoid / softmax / sinkhorn arithmetic after that is the stock one."""
    j = tl.arange(0, HC)
    jj = j[:, None]
    kk = j[None, :]
    if row < M:
        s_idx = tl.arange(0, SLICES_PAD)
        s_ok = s_idx < NUM_SLICES
        c = tl.arange(0, 32)
        v = tl.load(
            part_mix_ptr + (s_idx[:, None] * M + row) * MIX + c[None, :],
            mask=s_ok[:, None] & (c[None, :] < MIX),
            other=0.0,
            cache_modifier=".cv",
        )
        sq = tl.sum(
            tl.load(part_sq_ptr + s_idx * M + row, mask=s_ok, other=0.0, cache_modifier=".cv"),
            axis=0,
        )
        s0 = tl.load(scale_ptr + 0)
        s1 = tl.load(scale_ptr + 1)
        s2 = tl.load(scale_ptr + 2)
        b_pre = tl.load(base_ptr + j)
        b_post = tl.load(base_ptr + HC + j)
        b_comb = tl.load(base_ptr + 2 * HC + jj * HC + kk)
        red = tl.sum(v, axis=0)
        a_pre = tl.sum(tl.where(c[None, :] == j[:, None], red[None, :], 0.0), axis=1)
        a_post = tl.sum(tl.where(c[None, :] == (j[:, None] + HC), red[None, :], 0.0), axis=1)
        cidx = 2 * HC + jj * HC + kk
        a_comb = tl.sum(
            tl.where(c[None, None, :] == cidx[:, :, None], red[None, None, :], 0.0), axis=2
        )
        rsqrt = 1.0 / tl.sqrt(sq * inv_k + rms_eps)
        pre = tl.sigmoid(a_pre * rsqrt * s0 + b_pre) + EPS
        tl.store(pre_ptr + row * HC + j, pre)
        post = 2.0 * tl.sigmoid(a_post * rsqrt * s1 + b_post)
        tl.store(post_ptr + row * HC + j, post)
        comb = a_comb * rsqrt * s2 + b_comb
        comb = tl.exp(comb - tl.max(comb, axis=1)[:, None])
        comb = comb / tl.sum(comb, axis=1)[:, None] + EPS
        comb = comb / (tl.sum(comb, axis=0)[None, :] + EPS)
        for _ in tl.static_range(ITERS - 1):
            comb = comb / (tl.sum(comb, axis=1)[:, None] + EPS)
            comb = comb / (tl.sum(comb, axis=0)[None, :] + EPS)
        tl.store(comb_ptr + row * HC * HC + jj * HC + kk, comb)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the fused kernel
@triton.jit
def _hc_boundary_norm_fused_kernel(
    x_ptr,
    res_ptr,
    post_in_ptr,
    comb_in_ptr,
    pre_prev_ptr,
    w_ptr,
    res_out_ptr,
    part_mix_ptr,
    part_sq_ptr,
    part_ysq_ptr,
    nw_ptr,
    out_norm_ptr,
    out_fq_ptr,
    out_scale_ptr,
    scale_ptr,
    base_ptr,
    pre_ptr,
    post_ptr,
    comb_ptr,
    sync_ptr,
    M,
    H,
    x_stride_m,
    res_stride_m,
    w_stride_n,
    stride_nm,
    stride_fm,
    stride_sm,
    inv_k,
    rms_eps,
    norm_eps,
    inv_h,
    HC: tl.constexpr,
    MIX: tl.constexpr,
    MIX_PAD: tl.constexpr,
    BLOCK_M: tl.constexpr,
    BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr,
    NUM_SLICES: tl.constexpr,
    SLICES_PAD: tl.constexpr,
    HAS_POST: tl.constexpr,
    HAS_COMBINE: tl.constexpr,
    FAKE_QUANT: tl.constexpr,
    EMIT_FP8: tl.constexpr,
    ITERS: tl.constexpr,
    EPS: tl.constexpr,
    SYNC_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
):
    tl.static_assert(HC == 4)
    tl.static_assert(BLOCK_K % 32 == 0)
    TOTAL: tl.constexpr = NUM_SLICES + BLOCK_M
    pid_t = tl.program_id(0)  # fastest grid axis: a tile's CTAs are dispatched together
    pid_m = tl.program_id(1)
    cnt_ptr = sync_ptr + pid_m * SYNC_STRIDE
    if pid_t < NUM_SLICES:
        offs_m = (pid_m * BLOCK_M + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_M)).to(tl.int64)
        mask_m = offs_m < M
        offs_h = pid_t * BLOCK_K + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K)
        offs_n = tl.arange(0, MIX_PAD)
        mask_n = offs_n < MIX
        m2 = mask_m[:, None]

        # ---------- phase 1: the stock boundary body, every global load issued up front
        w_off = offs_n[None, :] * w_stride_n + offs_h[:, None]
        w0 = tl.load(w_ptr + w_off + 0 * H, mask=mask_n[None, :], other=0.0)
        w1 = tl.load(w_ptr + w_off + 1 * H, mask=mask_n[None, :], other=0.0)
        w2 = tl.load(w_ptr + w_off + 2 * H, mask=mask_n[None, :], other=0.0)
        w3 = tl.load(w_ptr + w_off + 3 * H, mask=mask_n[None, :], other=0.0)
        if HAS_POST:
            xa = tl.load(
                x_ptr + offs_m[:, None] * x_stride_m + offs_h[None, :], mask=m2, other=0.0
            ).to(tl.float32)
            cj = tl.arange(0, HC)
            post_tile = tl.load(
                post_in_ptr + offs_m[:, None] * HC + cj[None, :], mask=m2, other=0.0
            ).to(tl.float32)
            cc = tl.arange(0, HC * HC)
            comb_tile = tl.load(
                comb_in_ptr + offs_m[:, None] * (HC * HC) + cc[None, :], mask=m2, other=0.0
            ).to(tl.float32)
        r_off = offs_m[:, None] * res_stride_m + offs_h[None, :]
        r0 = tl.load(res_ptr + r_off + 0 * H, mask=m2, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
        r1 = tl.load(res_ptr + r_off + 1 * H, mask=m2, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
        r2 = tl.load(res_ptr + r_off + 2 * H, mask=m2, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
        r3 = tl.load(res_ptr + r_off + 3 * H, mask=m2, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
        if HAS_COMBINE:
            pj = tl.arange(0, HC)
            pre_tile = tl.load(
                pre_prev_ptr + offs_m[:, None] * HC + pj[None, :], mask=m2, other=0.0
            ).to(tl.float32)
        nw = tl.load(nw_ptr + offs_h).to(tl.float32)
        y = tl.zeros([BLOCK_M, BLOCK_K], dtype=tl.float32)
        acc = tl.zeros([BLOCK_M, MIX_PAD], dtype=tl.float32)
        sq = tl.zeros([BLOCK_M], dtype=tl.float32)
        for k in tl.static_range(HC):
            if k == 0:
                w_tile = w0
            elif k == 1:
                w_tile = w1
            elif k == 2:
                w_tile = w2
            else:
                w_tile = w3
            if HAS_POST:
                # res_out[k] = post[k]*x + sum_j comb[j,k]*res[j] in aiter::mhc_post's order
                pk = tl.sum(tl.where((cj == k)[None, :], post_tile, 0.0), axis=1)
                c0 = tl.sum(tl.where((cc == 0 * HC + k)[None, :], comb_tile, 0.0), axis=1)
                c1 = tl.sum(tl.where((cc == 1 * HC + k)[None, :], comb_tile, 0.0), axis=1)
                c2 = tl.sum(tl.where((cc == 2 * HC + k)[None, :], comb_tile, 0.0), axis=1)
                c3 = tl.sum(tl.where((cc == 3 * HC + k)[None, :], comb_tile, 0.0), axis=1)
                v = xa * pk[:, None]
                v += r0 * c0[:, None]
                v += r1 * c1[:, None]
                v += r2 * c2[:, None]
                v += r3 * c3[:, None]
                vb = v.to(res_out_ptr.dtype.element_ty)
                tl.store(
                    res_out_ptr + offs_m[:, None] * (HC * H) + k * H + offs_h[None, :],
                    vb,
                    mask=m2,
                )
                xt = vb.to(tl.float32)
            else:
                if k == 0:
                    xt = r0
                elif k == 1:
                    xt = r1
                elif k == 2:
                    xt = r2
                else:
                    xt = r3
            if HAS_COMBINE:
                pp = tl.sum(tl.where((pj == k)[None, :], pre_tile, 0.0), axis=1)
                y += pp[:, None] * xt
            else:
                if k == 0:
                    y = xt  # the norm input is copy 0 (stock: new_residual[:, 0, :])
            # xt is bf16-exact; hc_fn = w1 + w2 + w3 exactly in bf16 (24 mantissa bits): three bf16
            # MFMA products accumulate in fp32, smallest first
            xb = xt.to(tl.bfloat16)
            wb1 = w_tile.to(tl.bfloat16)
            wr = w_tile - wb1.to(tl.float32)
            wb2 = wr.to(tl.bfloat16)
            wb3 = (wr - wb2.to(tl.float32)).to(tl.bfloat16)
            acc = tl.dot(xb, wb3, acc)
            acc = tl.dot(xb, wb2, acc)
            acc = tl.dot(xb, wb1, acc)
            sq += tl.sum(xt * xt, axis=1)
        # the norm reads y as bf16 (stock: y stored bf16, then loaded by the norm row)
        yf = y.to(out_norm_ptr.dtype.element_ty).to(tl.float32)
        # what other CTAs of the tile read is written through to memory
        tl.store(
            part_mix_ptr + (pid_t * M + offs_m[:, None]) * MIX + offs_n[None, :],
            acc,
            mask=m2 & mask_n[None, :],
            cache_modifier=".wt",
        )
        tl.store(part_sq_ptr + pid_t * M + offs_m, sq, mask=mask_m, cache_modifier=".wt")
        tl.store(
            part_ysq_ptr + pid_t * M + offs_m,
            tl.sum(yf * yf, axis=1),
            mask=mask_m,
            cache_modifier=".wt",
        )
        # every wave's write-through stores are acknowledged before the CTA arrives
        tl.inline_asm_elementwise(
            "s_waitcnt vmcnt(0)", "=r,r", [pid_t], dtype=tl.int32, is_pure=False, pack=1
        )
        tl.debug_barrier()
        _arrive_and_wait(cnt_ptr, TOTAL)

        # ---------- phase 2: RMSNorm (+ MXFP8 / fp8-grid) of this CTA's [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_K] slice
        s_idx = tl.arange(0, SLICES_PAD)
        s_ok = s_idx < NUM_SLICES
        ysq = tl.load(
            part_ysq_ptr + s_idx[:, None] * M + offs_m[None, :],
            mask=s_ok[:, None] & mask_m[None, :],
            other=0.0,
            cache_modifier=".cv",
        )
        var = tl.sum(ysq, axis=0) * inv_h
        rstd = 1.0 / tl.sqrt_rn(var + norm_eps)
        yn = (yf * rstd[:, None] * nw[None, :]).to(out_norm_ptr.dtype.element_ty)
        tl.store(out_norm_ptr + offs_m[:, None] * stride_nm + offs_h[None, :], yn, mask=m2)
        if FAKE_QUANT:
            G: tl.constexpr = BLOCK_K // 32
            yg = tl.reshape(yn.to(tl.float32), (BLOCK_M * G, 32))
            q8, e8 = _fp8_grid_quant(yg)
            if EMIT_FP8:
                tl.store(
                    out_fq_ptr + offs_m[:, None] * stride_fm + offs_h[None, :],
                    tl.reshape(q8, (BLOCK_M, BLOCK_K)),
                    mask=m2,
                )
                goffs = pid_t * G + tl.arange(0, G)
                tl.store(
                    out_scale_ptr + offs_m[:, None] * stride_sm + goffs[None, :],
                    tl.reshape(e8.to(tl.uint8), (BLOCK_M, G)),
                    mask=m2,
                )
            else:
                qd = q8.to(tl.float32) * (e8 << 23).to(tl.float32, bitcast=True)[:, None]
                tl.store(
                    out_fq_ptr + offs_m[:, None] * stride_fm + offs_h[None, :],
                    tl.reshape(qd, (BLOCK_M, BLOCK_K)).to(out_fq_ptr.dtype.element_ty),
                    mask=m2,
                )
    else:
        # ---------- split-K reduce + sinkhorn of one row of the tile
        _arrive_and_wait(cnt_ptr, TOTAL)
        _sinkhorn_row(
            (pid_m * BLOCK_M + (pid_t - NUM_SLICES)).to(tl.int64),
            part_mix_ptr, part_sq_ptr, scale_ptr, base_ptr, pre_ptr, post_ptr, comb_ptr,
            M, inv_k, rms_eps, MIX=MIX, HC=HC, NUM_SLICES=NUM_SLICES,
            SLICES_PAD=SLICES_PAD, ITERS=ITERS, EPS=EPS,
        )


@functools.cache
def _barrier_counters(tiles, device):
    """Per-shape barrier counters, zeroed once outside any capture; every launch leaves them at zero
    again (the last arriver of each tile resets its counter)."""
    return torch.zeros(tiles * _SYNC_STRIDE, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)


def launch(
    *,
    x,
    residual,
    post_in,
    comb_in,
    pre_prev,
    hc_fn,
    hc_scale,
    hc_base,
    norm_weight,
    rms_eps,
    norm_eps,
    hc_eps,
    sinkhorn_iters,
    residual_out,
    norm,
    quantized,
    scales,
    pre,
    post,
    comb,
):
    """One launch: residual_out, norm (and, when quantized is given, its MXFP8 codes and scales),
    pre, post and comb of the boundary, written into the given outputs."""
    m, hc, h = residual.shape
    mix = hc_fn.shape[0]
    num_slices = h // _BLOCK_K
    tiles = triton.cdiv(m, _BLOCK_M)
    dev = residual.device
    part_mix = torch.empty((num_slices, m, mix), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev)
    part_sq = torch.empty((num_slices, m), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev)
    part_ysq = torch.empty((num_slices, m), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev)
    sync = _barrier_counters(tiles, dev)
    emit = quantized is not None
    _hc_boundary_norm_fused_kernel[(num_slices + _BLOCK_M, tiles)](
        x,
        residual,
        post_in,
        comb_in,
        pre_prev,
        hc_fn,
        residual_out,
        part_mix,
        part_sq,
        part_ysq,
        norm_weight,
        norm,
        quantized if emit else norm,
        scales.view(torch.uint8) if emit else norm,
        hc_scale,
        hc_base,
        pre,
        post,
        comb,
        sync,
        m,
        h,
        x.stride(0),
        residual.stride(0),
        hc_fn.stride(0),
        norm.stride(0),
        quantized.stride(0) if emit else 0,
        scales.stride(0) if emit else 0,
        1.0 / (hc * h),
        rms_eps,
        norm_eps,
        1.0 / h,
        HC=hc,
        MIX=mix,
        MIX_PAD=max(16, triton.next_power_of_2(mix)),
        BLOCK_M=_BLOCK_M,
        BLOCK_K=_BLOCK_K,
        NUM_SLICES=num_slices,
        SLICES_PAD=triton.next_power_of_2(num_slices),
        HAS_POST=True,
        HAS_COMBINE=True,
        FAKE_QUANT=emit,
        EMIT_FP8=emit,
        ITERS=sinkhorn_iters,
        EPS=hc_eps,
        SYNC_STRIDE=_SYNC_STRIDE,
        num_warps=_NUM_WARPS,
        num_stages=1,
        enable_fp_fusion=False,
    )

"""DeepSeek-V4 mHC sublayer boundary and the bf16 RMSNorm after it in one Triton launch (gfx950)."""

from .boundary import launch


def run(
    *,
    x,
    residual,
    post_in,
    comb_in,
    pre_prev,
    hc_fn,
    hc_scale,
    hc_base,
    norm_weight,
    rms_eps,
    norm_eps,
    hc_eps,
    sinkhorn_iters,
    residual_out,
    norm,
    pre,
    post,
    comb,
) -> None:
    launch(
        x=x,
        residual=residual,
        post_in=post_in,
        comb_in=comb_in,
        pre_prev=pre_prev,
        hc_fn=hc_fn,
        hc_scale=hc_scale,
        hc_base=hc_base,
        norm_weight=norm_weight,
        rms_eps=rms_eps,
        norm_eps=norm_eps,
        hc_eps=hc_eps,
        sinkhorn_iters=sinkhorn_iters,
        residual_out=residual_out,
        norm=norm,
        quantized=None,
        scales=None,
        pre=pre,
        post=post,
        comb=comb,
    )
